meta.name: Nick Ho Motorsports — homepage 98 entrance DNA
meta.description: A complete, implementation-oriented design DNA for the Nick Ho Motorsports homepage, centred on the opening '98' number sequence and its layered racing imagery. Color and interaction timing are visual/structural inferences because the site's runtime source is protected by Cloudflare; treat values marked inferred as production-ready starting parameters to tune against a live recording.

source_references.observed: Homepage exposes '98 / Car number', dark/yellow racing imagery, depth-map assets, drag controls, navigation, sound control and stat-led hero content.

meta.analysis_scope: Homepage entry through the first 98 number reveal
meta.parameter_confidence: Inferred timing and transform values; no protected runtime code was copied or inspected.

primary.role: near-black hero, navigation and high-contrast field

secondary.role: warm off-white type and light editorial surfaces

accent.role: Porsche-yellow racing cue, selective image/interaction emphasis

neutral.usage: Use #F3F0E8 on dark scenes; reserve #101010 for large fields and #8E8D88 for subdued labels.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast off-white-on-near-black dominant; yellow is not used as body text.

font_families.heading: Arial Narrow, Helvetica Neue Condensed, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Compressed neo-grotesk display lettering; oversized italic-free numeral; utilitarian small labels.

spacing.section_rhythm: Full-viewport scenes with sparse edge labels and large breathing gaps.

layout.alignment_tendency: mixed: edge-aligned metadata with central oversized visual focal point

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines only for functional controls

elevation.depth_cues: layer overlap, image cut-outs, depth-map displacement and contrast

motion.entrance_pattern: Oversized numeral resolves first, then layered image and peripheral metadata settle.
motion.exit_pattern: Fade/clip layers rather than bounce or spring.

components.button_style: textual, low-chrome, hairline or underline affordance
components.card_style: edge-to-edge photographic panels rather than floating cards
components.navigation_pattern: minimal top/edge navigation plus overlay menu
components.component_notes: Controls stay subordinate to the photography and the race number.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A racing number cutting through a dark pit-lane image stack.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: intentional full-bleed negative space around a single oversized focal number
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: central number and image stack dominate; metadata sits at edges
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element followed by progressive reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: photographic grain/motion blur rather than decorative UI texture

composition.hierarchy_method: extreme scale contrast plus spatial isolation
composition.grouping_strategy: number, label and stat are bound; imagery is layered behind
composition.negative_space_role: creates anticipation before the visual layers resolve

imagery.photo_treatment: dark exposure, saturated yellow accents, hard crop and occasional blur
imagery.graphic_elements: large racing number, fine rules, utilitarian labels

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle cursor/drag response and image depth movement

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: not observed; use terse monochrome copy

overview.fallback_strategy: Use a static composite hero image; disable drag/depth displacement and reduce motion to opacity-only.
overview.primary_technology: WebGL/Three.js or Canvas displacement plus GSAP

background_effects.description: Near-black full-viewport field; visual interest comes from image layers, not a procedural background.

3d_elements.description: Layered driver/car composition is supported by published depth-map assets, strongly indicating depth displacement or parallax rather than a flat image only.
3d_elements.technology: WebGL displacement plane or Canvas 2D depth layers

params.interaction_model: pointer drag / pointer move translates foreground 18px, midground 10px, background 4px

shader_effects.description: Use depth-map-driven UV offset to give the hero subject a shallow interactive 3D response.

params.fragment_output: sample photo UV offset by depth texture * uPointer * uDepthStrength

parallax.depth_range: 4px background, 10px midground, 18px foreground per pointer axis
parallax.speed_curve: pointer lerp 0.12; scroll translateY 0 to -8vh over first 100vh

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: hero entry is time-based; later imagery may use scrub: true with 0.15s smoothing

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll-driven shape morph is required for the 98 entrance.

text_effects.description: Treat '98' as two separately masked glyphs; bring them from a compressed/overscaled state into one lock-up, then reveal the 'Car number' label.

params.split_strategy: by-char for 9 and 8; by-word for supporting labels
params.stagger: 0.08s between numeral glyphs; 0.04s between peripheral labels
params.effect_style: masked vertical rise; no bounce; maintain a 100ms hold after numeral completion

cursor_effects.description: The homepage exposes a 'drag' affordance; use a circular text cursor only over the depth-image interaction zone.

image_effects.description: Hero image layers use shallow depth movement and a masked reveal under the number sequence.
image_effects.technology: WebGL depth displacement + CSS clip-path fallback

canvas_drawings.description: Canvas is optional only as a low-complexity substitute for the depth effect.

svg_animations.description: No SVG path-draw motif is necessary for the observed 98 entry.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Recommended entry sequence: t=0 dark field; t=0.10s begin 9; t=0.18s begin 8; t=0.25s begin image clip reveal; t=0.92s reveal 'Car number'; t=1.30s enable pointer drag. Keep the number above the image at z-index 3, supporting label at z-index 4, image/canvas at z-index 1 and near-black fallback at z-index 0. Use prefers-reduced-motion to show the final number/image state immediately with no blur, no clip-path and no pointer displacement.
